subject: Times may be duplicated or out of order error

messages.author: c8946d5bbd7693dc
messages.subject: Times may be duplicated or out of order error
parts:
Hi Chris,
I keep having some issues with the "times may be duplicated or out of order" error when doing as.telemetry(). I'm processing a 80 or so individuals and most of them work fine but a handful (~14 or so) will give me this error. Removing duplicate times solved some of them but I can't figure out what is going on with some others. I tried sorting to make sure they are in order but that didn't solve it either. Visually inspecting the data doesn't reveal any issues that I can see. Any ideas? Thanks!
Connor

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Times may be duplicated or out of order error
parts:
Hi Connor,

If the timestamps appear to be in order before import, it may be that the timeformat or timezone arguments need to be specified (which is often necessary when the timestamps aren't in canonical format and in UTC). If that still doesn't settle everything, then I can take a look at a data example.

Best,
Chris
